title: Apple Patches for October 2026, (Mon, Oct 26th)
description: Apple released security patches on October 26, 2026, addressing 304 vulnerabilities across multiple products including iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and Safari. The update includes fixes for several critical issues such as a previously exploited CoreGraphics vulnerability, unauthorized camera access by malicious apps, and local attacks on the Keychain. Other vulnerabilities allow privilege escalation, denial-of-service, memory corruption, arbitrary code execution, and bypass of security controls like Gatekeeper and Privacy preferences. The patches cover a wide range of components including Spotlight, Kernel, Mail, AppleAVD, Model I/O, and Screen Sharing Server. No new vulnerabilities are reported as already exploited in the wild in this update. The affected versions include recent releases of iOS, iPadOS, macOS Golden Gate, Tahoe, Sequoia, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and Safari.
